mentions.name: Italian cadastral data pipeline
mentions.description: Builds higher-quality cadastral data covering all of Italy for a client, combining PostGIS work with fuzzy string matching of government records, OSM, proprietary data, and aerial remote sensing data run through an ML pipeline.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building better quality cadastral data on all of Italy for a client, pretty fun postgis work. Fuzzy string matching of government records, OSM, proprietary data and aerial remote sensing data ran through an ML pipeline.
